reauth_oauth_callback.title: Complete Re-authentication
reauth_oauth_callback.description:
**Step 1:** Open the login URL:

[Click here to login]({authorization_url})

**Step 2:** Log in with your Philips account.

**Step 3:** After login, you'll see an error message about 'Failed to launch paw://login?code=...'. To get the callback URL:

1. Open Chrome DevTools (F12 or Right-click → Inspect)
2. Go to the Console tab
3. Find the error message that shows the `paw://login?code=...` URL
4. Right-click on that URL in the console
5. Select 'Copy' to copy the full URL
6. Paste it below

**Note:** You cannot copy the URL from the address bar. You must use Chrome DevTools console to copy the `paw://` URL.

data_description.callback_url: Paste the full redirect URL starting with 'paw://login?...' (copy from Chrome DevTools console)

data_description.camera_mode: The feeder allows only a few simultaneous camera connections, and opening one can disconnect the Philips app. 'Only while watching' connects on demand (recommended). data_description.camera_mode: The feeder allows only a few simultaneous camera connections, and opening one can disconnect the Philips app. 'Only while watching' connects on demand (recommended). 'Always on' keeps the stream up permanently, which external recorders need. 'Off' never connects to the camera.
data_description.idle_timeout_minutes: Only used when camera streaming is set to 'Only while watching'. When you close the camera view, Home Assistant waits this long before letting go of the camera. A longer wait makes opening the camera again instant; a shorter one hands the camera back to the Philips app sooner. Five minutes suits most people.
